purpose: Define the prospective eligible-source universe for Gold100 before large-scale candidate mining or deterministic sampling.

core_eligibility_gates.name: Canonical source identity
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: At least one authoritative persistent identifier or official document identity is bound, and title/authorship/organization/year are recoverable.

core_eligibility_gates.name: Exact source-text availability
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: The exact source text used by workers can be lawfully accessed by the study team, frozen or content-addressed, and SHA-256 bound.
core_eligibility_gates.exception: Only the predefined incomplete_or_missing_source_text stress stratum may intentionally fail full-text sufficiency.

core_eligibility_gates.name: Publication/version status resolvable
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: Publication status and current/corrected/retracted/living-version state are known or resolvable before eligible-pool freeze.

core_eligibility_gates.name: Evidence cutoff compatibility
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: Source existed by the frozen case evidence cutoff and no future-information leakage is required to interpret the frozen task.

core_eligibility_gates.name: Source-family mappability
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: Source maps unambiguously to one frozen source family and relevant Gold100 stratum.

core_eligibility_gates.name: Domain eligibility
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: Source maps to nutrition/metabolic/cardiometabolic or the held-out external biomedical/public-health domain.

core_eligibility_gates.name: StudyIdentity status
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: Underlying study/report relationship is resolved sufficiently to prevent accidental duplicate sampling or hidden dependence.

core_eligibility_gates.name: Scientific object extractability
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: Source contains at least one prospectively annotatable scientific object or critical-error opportunity under the R0 measurement contract.
core_eligibility_gates.exception: Predefined incomplete/missing-source stress cases may be eligible specifically because required content is unavailable, provided insufficiency is source-grounded and auditable.

core_eligibility_gates.name: Development-set non-overlap
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: Source is not one of the 20 Batch001 confirmatory-excluded development sources and is not a source-specific derivative that would recreate the same confirmatory case.

core_eligibility_gates.name: AB-performance independence
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: Eligibility and challenge tagging were decided without using AB0–AB6 outputs, scores, errors, or downstream performance.

core_eligibility_gates.name: Provenance completeness
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: Retrieval origin, retrieval time, identifier resolution, exact text identity/hash, transformation lineage, and screening decision are auditable.

core_eligibility_gates.name: No unresolved fatal integrity issue
core_eligibility_gates.pass_if: No unresolved source-identity, fabrication, unverifiable version, or irreconcilable provenance problem remains.

in_domain.rule: Domain assignment is based on the scientific source, not on whether the title contains the word nutrition.

external_domain.exclusion: No source whose primary scientific question is already inside the in-domain definition may be relabeled external merely to fill quota.

reproducibility_tier.A: Open or official full text with stable identifier and frozen hash.
reproducibility_tier.B: Lawfully accessed full text with stable bibliographic identity and frozen hash; redistribution may be restricted.
reproducibility_tier.C: Partial/abstract/missing text, eligible only for prespecified insufficiency stress use.
